description: Period-by-period schedule of a fixed-rate loan, monthly or quarterly: an optional interest-only period, then level payments on an amortization term that can run past maturity (balloon), with 30/360, actual/360, or actual/365 interest (the payment on a 30/360 basis). Rows are in cents that foot: interest is rounded each period, the final payment repays the whole balance, and the totals are the row sums. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.amortization_schedule@1, every step, and any warnings.

amortization_months.description: Amortization period in months that sets the level payment after any interest-only period, e.g. 360 for a 30-year schedule; 0 means interest-only to maturity. Must be at least term_months − interest_only_months (a shorter schedule would repay the loan before maturity).

day_count.description: Interest day count: "30/360" (each period is 30 days a month: interest = balance × rate ÷ periods a year), "actual/360" or "actual/365" (balance × rate × actual days in the period ÷ 360 or 365; needs start_date). Under actual day counts the level payment is still computed on a 30/360 basis, as US commercial loans usually are, so the balloon absorbs the difference.

interest_only_months.description: Months of interest-only payments at the start of the loan; amortization over amortization_months begins after them. At most term_months.

payment_frequency.description: Payment period: monthly (12 a year) or quarterly (4 a year). Term, amortization, and interest-only months must be whole periods.

principal.description: Loan amount funded, USD. Must be greater than 0.

rate_annual.description: Fixed nominal annual interest rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.065 for 6.5%. Must be less than 1.

start_date.description: Funding date, YYYY-MM-DD. Payment k falls k periods later on the same day of the month (clamped to month end); the first period runs from this date to the first payment date. Required for actual/360 and actual/365; optional for 30/360, where it only dates the rows.

term_months.description: Months from funding to maturity, when any remaining balance (the balloon) is repaid.

name: calc_amortization_schedule
title: Loan amortization schedule
